  1. It is said that seven out of ten young Japanese people don’t believe in religion.
    據說每十個日本年輕人裡就有七個不相信宗教。
  2. It is said that this temple is a thousand years old.
    據說這間廟有一千年的歷史。
  3. This temple is said to be a thousand years old.
    這間廟據說有一千年的歷史。
  4. It is said that green tea is good for your health.
    據說綠茶對健康很好。
  5. It is said that the old castle has a secret room.
    據說那座古堡有一個秘密房間。
  6. The owner of this shop is said to be very rich.
    這家店的老闆據說很有錢。
  7. Cats are said to have nine lives.
    據說貓有九條命。
  8. Nine out of ten students have a smartphone.
    十個學生裡有九個有智慧型手機。
  9. I got eight out of ten on the quiz.
    我小考十題對了八題。
  10. Three out of four people in this town drive to work.
    這個小鎮四個人裡有三個開車上班。
  11. Two out of five students walk to school.
    五個學生裡有兩個走路上學。
  12. One out of three Japanese people is over sixty.
    三個日本人裡有一個超過六十歲。
  13. It is said that this river is the cleanest in Japan.
    據說這條河是日本最乾淨的。
  14. He is said to speak five languages.
    據說他會說五種語言。
  15. It is said that this winter will be very cold.
    據說今年冬天會很冷。
  16. Four out of five dentists say this toothpaste is good.
    五個牙醫裡有四個說這種牙膏很好。
  17. Only two out of twenty students got full marks.
    二十個學生裡只有兩個拿滿分。
  18. This bridge is said to be the oldest in the city.
    這座橋據說是市裡最古老的。
  19. It is said that eight out of ten Japanese families have a car.
    據說十個日本家庭裡有八個有車。
  20. It is said that many young people don't believe in luck.
    據說很多年輕人不相信運氣。
  21. Seven out of ten people in this survey believe in ghosts.
    這份調查裡，十個人中有七個相信有鬼。
  22. It is said that the first train in Taiwan ran in 1891.
    據說台灣的第一列火車在一八九一年開始行駛。
  23. Tom is said to be the fastest runner in our school.
    Tom 據說是我們學校跑得最快的人。
  24. Only one out of ten students passed the test.
    十個學生裡只有一個通過考試。
  25. It is said that four out of five children in this city start learning English before elementary school.
    據說這個城市五個小孩裡有四個在上小學前就開始學英文。
  26. It is said that many Japanese people visit temples on New Year's Day.
    據說很多日本人元旦會去寺廟。
  27. It is said that Kyoto has more than a thousand temples.
    據說京都有超過一千間寺廟。
  28. It is said that eating fish makes you smart.
    據說吃魚會讓你變聰明。
  29. Six out of ten visitors to this museum come from abroad.
    這間博物館的遊客十個裡有六個來自國外。
  30. This lake is said to be the deepest in Japan.
    這個湖據說是日本最深的。
  31. My grandmother believes in God.
    我奶奶信上帝。
  32. Do you believe in ghosts?
    你相信有鬼嗎？
  33. I believe you.
    我相信你說的。
  34. Nobody believed his story.
    沒有人相信他說的事。
  35. Ken got only three out of ten on the spelling test.
    Ken 的拼字考試十題只對了三題。
